items.title: Why Is Oracle (ORCL) Expanding Its Health Data Network With Federal Agencies?
items.summary: Oracle (NYSE: ORCL) said the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs and Department of War joined the Oracle Health Information Network. The Oracle Health Information Network is a federally designated Qualified Health Information Network that supports nationwide health data exchange. This move is intended to give clinicians across federal and community settings broader, secure access to patient health information. items.title: Nvidia’s Interim CEO Pushed Back on a “$250 Billion Credit Backstop” for OpenAI. Oracle Has the Most at Stake
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Information reports that Nvidia’s interim CEO, Colette Kress, pushed back on a proposed $250 billion credit backstop for OpenAI while she was finance chief, and that Nvidia is expected to slow its AI investment strategy. Oracle has the most at stake: Steve Eisman puts about half of its $664 billion backlog with OpenAI, and its free cash flow was negative $23.
